name: ELM benchmark for PV prediction
description: A benchmark of simple statistical models for photovoltaic power forecasting (AC output, after the inverter) across horizons from 30 minutes to 10 hours ahead. Compares persistence baselines, convex BLEND combinations, a linear AR-OLS model, and a family of Extreme Learning Machine variants differing in loss function and regularization, together with foundation-model and NeuralProphet references. Models are evaluated with skill scores against persistence on several PV sites.
